# `storage` tools

8 tools in the `storage` operation domain. This reference covers every tool the server registers, including the ones a default deployment does not expose. See the [tool reference index](index.md) for every domain.

The Summary column on each domain page is the first line of the tool's MCP description. The complete text, including the conditions under which a tool refuses, is the tool handler's docstring under `src/hmcpctl/server_tools/`. An MCP client receives that docstring's prose as the tool's description and its argument detail in the input schema; `Returns:` and `Raises:` sections are not sent.

| Tool | Effect | Operation | Target | Implementation | Verification | Runtime eligibility | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hmc_attach_disk_to_lpar` | `mutate` | `storage.attach_disk` | `lpar` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Create and attach a virtual disk; concurrent VolumeGroup changes can be lost. |
| `hmc_create_virtual_disk` | `mutate` | `storage.create_disk` | `vios` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Create a virtual disk (logical volume); concurrent VolumeGroup changes can be lost. |
| `hmc_create_volume_group` | `mutate` | `storage.create_volume_group` | `vios` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Create a Volume Group on a VIOS from one or more physical volumes. |
| `hmc_delete_virtual_disk` | `destructive` | `storage.delete_disk` | `vios` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Delete a virtual disk (logical volume); concurrent VolumeGroup changes can be lost. |
| `hmc_detach_storage_mapping` | `destructive` | `storage.detach_mapping` | `vios` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Detach a VirtualSCSIMapping by its inventory ID. |
| `hmc_list_storage_mappings` | `read` | `storage.list_mappings` | `vios` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | List VirtualSCSIMappings on a VIOS, optionally filtered by LPAR. |
| `hmc_list_volume_groups` | `read` | `storage.list_volume_groups` | `vios` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | List Volume Groups on a VIOS. |
| `hmc_map_storage_to_lpar` | `mutate` | `storage.map` | `vios` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Map backing storage to an LPAR via a Virtual SCSI mapping on a VIOS. |
